name: Invocations
title: Blocks/Detail/Invocations
summary: The Invocation page of one function run, as a page body for ConsoleLayout: one run end to end. A `PageHeader` titled Invocation opens on the invocation summary `Card` (the function `Link`, the copyable invocation ID with its `StatusIndicator`, Replay, the Recent switcher, an outlined `Button` whose `DropdownMenu` picks another invocation, the Invocation actions menu with Open in Real-Time Events and Function settings, the Started, Completed, Duration and Location facts, and the triggering request with its outcome). Below it the Request path is a `FlowDiagram` with one node per hop (service, resource, function, origin), each with its `Tag`, its facts and the time spent there; a node's `IconButton` selects its span in the `Trace` waterfall and scrolls it into view. The `LogViewer` lists what the function printed, timed on the same clock as the trace. The Error variant opens on a run the origin timed out, with the failing span selected; Running shows a run still in progress, its spans running and the lines printed so far under a Streaming indicator. Built from `PageHeader`, `Card`, `Tooltip`, `CopyButton`, `StatusIndicator`, `Button`, `DropdownMenu`, `IconButton`, `Link`, `SectionHeader`, `FlowDiagram`, `Tag`, `Trace`, `LogViewer` and `LogViewerContent`; Replay reports through `toast`.

variants.name: Error
variants.summary: A run the origin timed out: the danger status, the outcome in danger color, the function and origin nodes tagged Failed and Timed out, the failing origin-response span selected in the trace with its message, and the warning lines in the logs.

variants.name: Running
variants.summary: A run still in progress: a loading Running status, Replay disabled, Completed reading Not yet, the function and origin nodes tagged Running and Waiting, the spans running in the trace and the lines printed so far kept on screen, with a loading Streaming `StatusIndicator` in the Logs header.
